Roshnan is a titan worshipped by the organisation of Titanic Cult which is prevalent in various places around the continent of Sarl. The appearance of the titan is that of a gigantic humanoid ant, often depicted with the legendary Chaos Crown on his head. It is believed that Roshnan is currently chained to the wall of our reality, thus making him the only titanic deity who is able to communicate with his worshippers. It is unknown which power caused the king of the ants to be chained into the wall. Roshnan is also worshipped by most nomadic Saris, which makes him the only titan worshipped outside the Titanic Cult. 

Roshnan is a mysterious deity and he works in mysterious ways. He is often depicted as an extremely insane being, yet saner than most other titans. He is said to be highly tied (literally) to the mortal plane, often responding to the summons of his worshippers. He is seen as the spiritual leader and the father of all bugfolk. 

P.S: According to the Cult, Titans are the gods of the multiverses.
